Change c0458. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XXIII.

Context before (unchanged): I pointed to the spot where he had disappeared, and we followed the track with boats; nets were cast, but in vain.

1818 text: After passing several hours, we returned hopeless, most of my companions believing it to have been a form conjured by my fancy.

1831 text: After passing several hours, we returned hopeless, most of my companions believing it to have been a form conjured up by my fancy.

Diff: After passing several hours, we returned hopeless, most of my companions believing it to have been a form conjured {+up+} by my fancy.
